description: This file defines API endpoints for managing dealers in a dealership management system using FastAPI. It includes functions to list, create, update, and delete dealer records, with defined request and response schemas.

methods.name: List[Dealer] list_dealers( limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=200, description="Max number of dealers to return"), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Number of dealers to skip"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a paginated list of dealers, ordered by name.

methods.name: Dealer create_dealer(payload: DealerCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new dealer record in the database.

methods.name: Dealer update_dealer(dealer_id: int, payload: DealerUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to update an existing dealer identified by dealer_id.

methods.name: None delete_dealer(dealer_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a dealer identified by dealer_id.
